''See also: [[Archlady Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Archlady is a title held by high-ranking individuals, such as [[Emissary Kahn Mala]] of [[Redmoon Hall]]. One such Archlady is a human woman with gray-streaked hair and a serpent-shaped [[Blood Shadow]]. [[Kahn Mala]] serves as an emissary for the [[Redmoon Herald]] and the [[Sage of Red Faith]], acting with the goal of providing protection to others. She is characterized by a commanding presence, though she may appear physically gaunt or weathered by age. In her role, she manages security inspections, maintains sect defenses, and handles diplomatic or protective duties on behalf of her organization. The title is associated with significant power and [[advancement]], involving personal revelations that define an individual's purpose or identity.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|This female human possesses navy hair reminiscent of the deep ocean, which is streaked with gray. Her skin is the color of a summer sky, and she wears wristbands along with a scripted necklace.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|She serves as [[Emissary Kahn Mala]] and acts as an attendant to the [[Sage of Red Faith]], whom she salutes. Additionally, she possesses the capacity to focus on the governance of territory.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|She utilizes the [[sword]]-[[Path]] and has the power to release crackling lightning-sparrows. She is also associated with a [[Shadow]] that takes the form of a serpent.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The silver [[Remnant]] known as the Archlady hails from [[Everwood]] and is distinguished by a halo positioned behind her head. During her travels, she released crackling lightning-sparrows and landed upon a cliff accompanied by a [[Blood Shadow]] shaped like a snake. She is also known to travel alongside the [[Sage of Red Faith]].}}
